arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive:{/c} Raise a skeletal warrior from a nearby Corpse every {c_number}2{/c} seconds, up to a maximum of {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} warriors. Skeletal warriors deal {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_SWORD}{/c} with each attack.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Command your skeletal warriors to leap at an enemy and attack.
{c_important}Skeleton Warrior's{/c} maximum number of warriors is increased by {c_number}{SF_38}{/c}.

{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} lose {c_number}[SF_50*100|%|]{/c} of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing {c_number}{payload:DEATH_EXPLOSION}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} are now raised from a nearby Corpse every {c_number}[{SF_47}|1|]{/c} seconds.

If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, {c_important}Skeleton Warrior{/c} briefly Summons a {c_important}Skeleton Priest{/c} instead.

{c_important}Skeleton Priest{/c} empowers your {c_important}Minions{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}[{SF_63} * 100|%+|]{/c} and healing them for {c_number}100%{/c} of their Maximum Life over the duration.
Commanding your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} causes them to deal {c_number}[SF_15*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}{SF_54}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} heal you for {c_number}[{SF_46}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_46]){/c} whenever they attack.
{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} have a {c_number}[SF_51*100|%|]{/c} chance to make enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_52}{/c} seconds.
Commanding your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_53}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}.
